description: This Java source file defines the AlarmController class, an Android Activity that provides a user interface for scheduling one-shot and repeating alarms using AlarmManager. It handles button clicks to set or cancel alarms, and demonstrates the use of PendingIntent, Calendar, and AlarmManager APIs to manage system alarms.

classes.name: AlarmController
classes.description: An Android Activity that allows users to schedule, start, and stop alarms (both one-shot and repeating) via UI buttons, demonstrating alarm management APIs.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and attaches click listeners to control buttons.

methods.name: mOneShotListener
methods.description: Defines the behavior when the one-shot alarm button is clicked: schedules a single alarm to go off after 30 seconds.

methods.name: mStartRepeatingListener
methods.description: Defines behavior to start a repeating alarm that first triggers after 15 seconds and repeats every 15 seconds.

methods.name: mStopRepeatingListener
methods.description: Provides logic to cancel a previously scheduled repeating alarm.
